spans.s: सभक्तिकम् स-भक्तिकम्, ind. respectfully.

सभद्रमुस्त स-भद्रमुस्त, अस्, आ, अम्, full
of Cyperus Rotundus, (also read सु-भ्˚.)

सभय स-भय, अस्, आ, अम्, fearful, appre-
hensive; (अम्), ind. with fear, timidly.

सभरस् स-भरस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, Ved. bearing
together.

सभर्तृका स-भर्तृका, f. ‘having a hus-
band,’ a woman whose husband is alive.

सभा सभा, f. (said to be fr. rt. 1. भा
with स, because people, सह भान्ति, ‘appear
together’ at a place of meeting), an assembly, con-
[]
gregation, meeting, company, society, good society;
Society (personified as a daughter of Prajā-pati); a
council, council-chamber, hall; a court of justice;
a court, palace [cf. राज-स्˚]; a public audience,
levee; a gaming room, gambling house; any
house or large room or frequented place.
—सभा-
चातुर्य, अम्, n. politeness in society.
—सभाचार
(˚भा-आच्˚), अस्, m. the customs or usages of society,
court-manners.
—सभा-धैर्य, अम्, n. boldness in
company.
—सभा-नर, अस्, m. a proper N.
—स-
भा-नायक, अस्, or सभा-पति, इस्, m. the president
of an assembly, chairman; the keeper of a gaming
house.
—सभा-पर्वन्, अ, n., N. of the second book
of the Mahā-bhārata (which describes the holding of
a great assembly at Hastināpura and the gambling
between Yudhi-ṣṭhira and Śakuni, in which the
former staked and lost all his possessions, including
his territory and his wife Draupadī).
—सभा-पूजा,
f. respect or reverence paid to the audience (in the
prelude of a drama).
—सभा-मण्डन, अम्, n. the
adorning or arranging of an assembly-room.
—सभा-
वशकर, अस्, ई, अम्, controlling or influencing an
assembly.
—सभा-सद्, त्, m. one who sits at an
assembly, a member of any society or company,
an assistant at an assembly or meeting; (in law) an
assessor, one who sits in a court of justice, a judge.
—सभा-सह, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. one who restrains
or rules an assembly.
—सभा-सिंह, अस्, m., N. of
a king.
—सभास्तार (˚भा-आस्˚), अस्, m. an assistant
at an assembly, one of a society or company.
—सभा-
स्थ, अस्, आ, अम्, being at an assembly or court; (अस्),
m. one who sits in an assembly; a courtier.
—स-
भोचित (˚भा-उच्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, fit for an assembly,
fit for good society; (अस्), m. a learned Brāhman,
any learned or educated person.
—सभोद्देश (˚भा-
उद्˚), the neighbourhood of any place of meeting;
the precincts of a house, &c.
सभिक, अस्, m. the keeper of a gaming house.
सभीक, अस्, m. = सभिक above.

सभेय, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. relating to an assembly,
skilled in council, shining in society.

सभ्य, अस्, आ, अम्, belonging or relating to an
assembly, fit for an assembly; suitable to good
society; fit for a court; polite; refined, civilized,
(अ-सभ्य, अस्, आ, अम्, not met with in good society,
not used in the best society, unrefined, indecorous);
trusted, confidential, faithful; (अस्), m. an assistant
at an assembly; an assessor; a person of honourable
parentage; N. of one of the five sacred fires; the
keeper of a gaming house; the servant of a keeper
of a gaming house; [cf. Old Germ. sibba, sibbi,
sibbo, ga-sibbo, ga-sibbot; Goth. trasti-sibja,
ga-sibjon, un-sibja; Angl. Sax. sib, sibbe, ge-sib.]
—सभ्य-तम, अस्, आ, अम्, most worthy of an
assembly, very senatorial or oratorical, very polite or
refined; (अस्), m. a very polite or refined person, an
ornament of society.
—सभ्य-ता, f. or सभ्य-त्व,
अम्, n. politeness, refinement, good breeding.
—स-
भ्येतर (˚य-इत्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, ‘contrary to good
society,’ vulgar.

सभाज् सभाज्, cl. 10. P. सभाजयति,
यितुम्, Aor. अससभाजत्, to serve,
honour, worship; to salute; to please, gratify, satisfy,
exhilarate; to beautify; to show.

सभाजन, अम्, n. service, honour, courtesy,
politeness, civility in receiving or taking leave of a
friend.

सभाजित, अस्, आ, अम्, served, honoured, treated
with courtesy, gratified, pleased.

सभार्य स-भार्य or स-भार्यक, अस्, आ,
अम्, with a wife, having a wife.
सभावन स-भावन, अस्, m. epithet of Śiva.
सभासद् सभा-सद्. See under सभा.

सभीति स-भीति, इस्, इस्, इ, having fear, fear-
ful, timid.

सभीम स-भीम, अस्, आ, अम्, together with
Bhīma.

सभृकुटीमुख स-भृकुटी-मुख, अस्, आ, अम्,
having a frowning face, frowning.

सभृत्य स-भृत्य, अस्, आ, अम्, attended by
servants, with (the assistance of) servants.

सभ्रातृ स-भ्रातृ, ता, त्री, तृ, with a brother,
attended by brethren.
स-भ्रातृक, अस्, आ, अम्, = स-भ्रातृ.

सभ्रूभङ्ग स-भ्रूभङ्ग, अस्, आ, अम्, with a
frown, frowning, knitting the brows; (अम्), ind.
frowningly.

साभिकाम साभिकाम (स-अभ्˚), अस्, आ, अम्,
possessing love or affection, loving, affectionate.

साभिप्राय साभिप्राय (स-अभ्˚), अस्, आ, अम्,
having an aim or purpose, persevering, resolute.

साभिमान साभिमान (स-अभ्˚), अस्, आ, अम्,
full of pride, haughty, proud.

साभिलाष साभिलाष (स-अभ्˚), अस्, आ, अम्,
full of desire, eager; (अम्), ind. wishfully, eagerly,
passionately.

साभ्यसूय साभ्यसूय (स-अभ्˚), अस्, आ, अम्,
full of envy, envious, malicious.

साभ्र साभ्र (स-अभ्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, having
clouds, covered with clouds, overcast, cloudy.
साभ्रमती साभ्रमती, f., N. of a place.
